Health Monitor is a centralized read-only view of the Vital Reports Framework's runtime health: recent Apex batch jobs, framework scheduled crons, and recent dashboard-run errors.

The page is observability-only. Every action that modifies state happens in Salesforce Setup, except for one targeted helper: when the nightly ETL cron is missing (typically after a sandbox refresh), a button lets you re-register it with one click. No batches run immediately and no existing schedule can be modified from here.
